summary: The register holds 39 questions, of which 15 are candidates, 23 are parked after gate failure or adversarial check and 1 is merged. Baseline synthesis is incomplete: the citation benchmark, the baseline report and the guideline extracts are outstanding, and the appraisal backlog stands at about 8,400 records. Europe PMC recovered this run after the 503 responses of 24 October.

domain_narratives.D1: Coronary intervention: PubMed monthly counts for the domain query totalled 6,400 entries in the 12 months to September 2026, against 5,643 in the preceding 12 months, a change of +13%. Counts are by entry date and include all designs, so the rise partly reflects overall growth in indexing and the broadened queries of version 2. The appraised subset is still a minority of the store, so topic-level movement is described in the landscape files rather than here.

validation: Seed recall was 100% in all nine domains. Core-journal completeness was 0.821 (12 of 67 indexed in-scope Crossref items missing), below the 98% target; the misses were judged mostly out of scope or borderline on title, with no query change. The precision sample was not repeated this month.
